title: Motor imagery BCI dataset with pupillometry augmentation
description: EEG recordings from 30 healthy participants performing a left-hand grasping motor imagery task versus rest, cued by auditory stimuli, with simultaneous pupillometry. The dataset was recorded with a 32-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz across two runs of 25 trials per subject. It supports evaluating whether task-evoked pupil diameter changes can improve EEG-based motor imagery brain-computer interface classification.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system (sintered Ag/AgCl active electrodes, CMS/DRL reference) at 512 Hz. Each participant completed two experiments of 25 trials, each 6 s long, alternating left-hand grasping imagery and rest with auditory cues. Pupil diameter was recorded alongside the EEG. Separately, the MOABB benchmark used 8-30 Hz bandpass filtering, CSP features with pupil diameter, and LDA classification with 10-fold within-subject cross-validation.
